# The Ummed Haveli

> A 4-star heritage hotel in Krishi Nagar, Budh Singhpura, Sanganer — just 2 km (about 5 minutes) from Terminal 1 of Jaipur International Airport, Rajasthan, India. Royal Rajasthani haveli architecture, 21 rooms, and a pure-vegetarian rooftop restaurant with panoramic views of the airport runway and the Aravalli hills.

## Key facts
- Name: The Ummed Haveli (also "Ummed Haveli Jaipur")
- Type: Heritage hotel, 4-star
- Address: Krishi Nagar, Budh Singhpura, Near Terminal 1 Airport, Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302029, India
- Distance to Jaipur Airport (JAI): ~2 km, ~5 minutes
- Rooms: 21 — Royal Deluxe Room (City View) and Royal Premium Room (Airport View)
- Phone: +91 72968 12341
- Email: theummedhaveli@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.ummedhaveli.com
- Check-in: 12:00 PM · Check-out: 11:00 AM
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Payments: Cash, Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking

## Restaurant
- Hawai Jharokha — pure-vegetarian rooftop multi-cuisine restaurant
- Cuisines: Rajasthani, North Indian, Continental, Italian
- Open daily, 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM, reservations accepted
- Menu and prices: https://www.ummedhaveli.com/hawai-jharokha

## Highlights
- Closest luxury heritage hotel to Jaipur Airport Terminal 1
- Rooftop dining with direct airport-runway and Aravalli views
- Free Wi-Fi, free parking, 24/7 room service, air conditioning, banquet hall, travel desk
- Specialises in wedding-guest group bookings (block rates for 10–50+ rooms)
- Ideal for early-morning or late-night flights, layovers, and South Jaipur business travel (Sitapura EPIP, JECC)

## Booking
Book direct at https://www.ummedhaveli.com for the best rates (typically 15% better than OTAs). Contact via phone, WhatsApp, email, or the on-site booking form.
